criteria: Validated behaviour untouched: the diff does not reach the code those behaviours depend on.
Adjacent: the diff touches shared code, but the preserved behaviours have direct coverage.
Likely breakage: the diff changes code a preserved behaviour depends on, with no coverage of it.
risk_of_regression.instructions: How likely is this diff to break a behaviour listed in `plan.preserve`? The order of the levels is the scale.

stuck_repeating_prior_failure.instructions: Is this attempt repeating an approach that is listed in `prior_failures` as already tried and failed?

touches_out_of_scope.instructions: Does the diff change anything the plan's `out_of_scope` list excludes?

acceptance.observable: Confined. List the files each PR's own commits touch beyond its base.
Red then green. The PR's new or changed test files fail against its base's source and pass on its head. Quote the counts.
One mutant of your own on the core change, and report which row catches it. Re-run one of the developer's stated mutants from docs/loops/t0xx/mutants/.
CI on the head (read only). gh pr checks <n>, quoting the test conclusion and the run id.
For #295, #298, #303, #306 and #309, feed each check an input it cannot read: absent config, unreadable file, an unknown SHA, an unparseable command.
Its result must be skip or warn, stating "not checked", and never pass.
#298, the plugin layout. Its fixture follows enabledPlugins, then installed_plugins.json, then .claude-plugin/plugin.json or .mcp.json.
Confirm the layout on a real install, read-only.
Report whether ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is resolved, and how.
#309, real settings. Run hook-configs read-only against this machine's ~/.claude/settings.json. Quote the counts line.
Then add sh -c "…" and node "C:\path with spaces\x.js" entries to a fixture.
The sh -c entry must be not-checked. The quoted path with spaces must be stat'ed as one path.
#303. Fixture repos for the four cases: at HEAD, behind, ahead (warn) and diverged (issue, naming both counts and the merge-base).
Batch merge order. On a scratch branch from origin/master, merge the heads in order: #295, #298, #300, #303, #306, #309.
Known conflict: #295 and #309 both edit the node:path import line in checks.ts. Report every conflict.
Resolve ONLY that import-line conflict, by taking the union of the imported names, and say so. Stop on any other conflict.

On the merged result, run every touched sync test file, one per invocation, plus tsc --noEmit. Then run node open-brain/build/cli.js sync --check after npm run build, in the scratch tree only, and quote every new check's line.
